clusters.name: Your grandfather Amos's death, 1989–1990
clusters.reason: Around your grandfather's death in July 1989, within the following months: your mother's worry over money in March 1988 and her distance from your father over it by May 1988, your brother's grades falling by November 1989, and your mother's anxiety easing once back at work by March 1990. The shifts pile up across the household in these months, with no one else's showing then.

clusters.name: Your mother Della told she had breast cancer, 1995–1996
clusters.reason: Around your mother being told she had breast cancer in February 1995, within the following months: your migraines in March 1994 and your calls to your brother most nights by April 1994, your turning away from him by June 1995, and your distance from your mother by February 1996. You left home for college in September 1993, and the shifts in your relationship moves and symptoms cluster in the years after your mother's diagnosis.
